name: Shell Celestite
original_name: シェル・セレスタイト
source:
"...That stupid face is in my way. Move!"

2nd year high school student.
Star Sign: Cancer
A rival from an elite noble family.

The son of a noble family that has the blood of the royal family, and an honor student.
Whenever he gets involved with Lapis he has to say something mean.
A fellow classmate at the magic school in the human world, and Jasper's cousin.
